sentences.text: The evidence does not show a car-loan-specific foreclosure charge for this bank.
The bank’s loan documents that mention foreclosure or pre-payment state a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding in one agreement and 3% of principal outstanding in the copied agreement.
The RBI 2014 foreclosure-charge circular is no longer in force, and the later 2025 pre-payment-charge directions were also later withdrawn, so those sources do not currently set the charge.

A current UCB rule on pre-payment charges exists, but the rule findings say it needs facility, rate type, and sanction date to determine whether it applies to this case, and those facts are not in the evidence for the car-loan question.

missing.searched: searched the bank’s loan-policy and loan-agreement evidence for a car-loan-specific foreclosure or pre-payment charge; only home-loan and general term-loan pre-payment terms were found
searched for facility, rate_type, and sanction_date needed to apply the current UCB pre-payment-charge rules
